breakdown.description: Compression process is labeled isothermal but isentropic temperature relation is used (process-model inconsistency).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original error verbatim: it labels the compression as 'isothermal' while applying the isentropic temperature relation T2/T1 = (p2/p1)^((γ-1)/γ). The ground truth requires either correcting the process to 'isentropic' or noting that isothermal compression means T2=T1. The agent did neither.
